title: Webコミュニケーション
subtitle: Web Communication
educationalGoal: In this course, Students will achieve the following three objectives: 1) Mechanism that operates web application 2) Basic technologies for web applications such as HTML, CSS, Javascript, HTTP, and CGI. 3) Creating a web application using the framework include URL routing, template engines, object relation mappers, and front-end technologies.
advice: To develop programs required for web applications, it is necessary to understanding web technologies. To understanding the importance of web applications, it is importance to experience it during the software development. In this course, students will experience to develop web application using framework. The following main topic will be covered: 1) Mechanism that operates Web application 2) Basic technologies for web applications such as HTML, CSS, Javascript, HTTP, and CGI. 3) Creating a web application using the framework include URL routing, template engines, object relation mappers, and front-end technologies.
books: Textbook: Reference book: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: In this course, It is assumed that students have already learned programming, database, and network knowledge. Students need skills such as using text editor, file operation, terminal application, and, browser. Note: Bring your laptop computer.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain basic web technology such as HTTP, HTML, CSS, and CGI.
Be able to explain Mechanism for running web applications.
Be able to explain function of front-end, back-end, and framework.
Be able to create a web application using some materials.
